scope: Conditions reachable from production Think that can recognize benchmark-shaped inputs, inject benchmark-requested outputs, or admit external evaluator/demo context.

hooks.name: runtime_reasoning_augmentor_entry_points
hooks.activation: Any installed package may register company_os.reasoning_augmentors; discovery is automatic and has no production allowlist or benchmark-mode fence.
hooks.effect: Arbitrary async augmentors may mutate the retrieved ContextBundle and expand allowed_region before reasoning.
hooks.risk: A demo, evaluator, or other installed distribution can silently change production reasoning context and mutation authority without appearing in the core commit.
hooks.required_p1_disposition: Remove production reachability or require an explicit governed production-safe registration contract whose identity is included in run receipts.

hooks.name: capability_probe_diff_injector
hooks.activation: A T1 signal or batch fragment contains capability_probe plus recognized capability_probe_kinds vocabulary.
hooks.effect: Deterministically appends prediction, resource, ontology-gap, archive, evidence-attachment, or question-policy operations after the LLM response and before validation/apply.
hooks.risk: The benchmark can request the exact rare output surfaces it later scores, so the output is not evidence of spontaneous company understanding.
hooks.required_p1_disposition: Delete from production Think reachability; evaluate rare surfaces with sealed inputs and independent outcome checks.

hooks.name: pricing_transition_bridge_injector
hooks.activation: A batch contains at least two observations and matches hard-coded pricing plus before-state, after-state, and missing-transition phrase families.
hooks.effect: Appends a fixed-form bounded pricing-transition hypothesis with confidence 0.58 after the LLM response.
hooks.risk: A benchmark storyline uses the same distinctive vocabulary as the production detector, allowing phrase recognition to masquerade as general hidden-pattern inference.
hooks.required_p1_disposition: Either remove the injector from production reasoning or reframe it as a separately evaluated domain rule with broad counterfactual and paraphrase populations; it cannot support general synthesis claims.

hooks.name: noise_phrase_fast_path
hooks.activation: A T1 trigger matches hard-coded noise channel/text markers while avoiding an actionable keyword list.
hooks.effect: Skips retrieval and the LLM and emits an empty noise no-op diff.
hooks.risk: The benchmark produces and scores recognizable noise phrasing; a phrase list can earn noise-handling credit without robust semantic classification and may discard real signals that omit the small actionable lexicon.
hooks.required_p1_disposition: Replace benchmark-aligned phrases with an independently evaluated semantic classifier or policy whose false-negative behavior is measured on adversarial paraphrases.

explicit_non_findings.claim: No direct import of fyralis_demo, demo, or simulation was found in services.reasoning.
explicit_non_findings.boundary: This does not make BH-001 safe because entry-point loading is dynamic.

explicit_non_findings.claim: Generic SAGE bridge topology terms are not classified as benchmark hooks.
explicit_non_findings.boundary: Only production conditions tied to benchmark-shaped semantic inputs or external augmentation were inventoried.

completion_rule: P0-B is complete when every listed source anchor still resolves and an independent scan finds no additional production-reachable benchmark/evaluator condition. HG-01 remains failed until P1 removes or governs all listed reachability.
